text: Dispatch envelope for this run: every agent stage is dispatched as one fresh Factory Droid worker subagent with no inherited conversation, on the model the host labels Opus 5.5 (Factory Droid CLI 0.249.0). Host deviation: Factory Droid exposes no exact per-dispatch reasoning-effort control, only complexity tiers capped at the driver session's own level, so every agent stage is dispatched at the highest tier, heavy, whether its packet declares high or xhigh; the packet's declared effort is recorded in generation provenance beside the host tier. Each worker is handed the packet by its exact path and SHA-256 and reads it in full. The driver adds only: the result path, a worker-owned scratch directory, the checkout path, the model identity, declared effort and host tier for generation provenance, the host note that Python Markdown 3.11 is installed while the repository pins 3.10.3 (with the path of a pinned scratch virtualenv to put first on PATH), the instruction that the driver alone runs git and tpt advance (an installer lists paths and hashes to stage instead), the instruction to edit nothing outside what the packet assigns (in particular no tool, script or registry change, because the research seal covers them; a shared-tool defect is recorded for its owner), and the instruction, following the production plan's independence terms, not to open the published GPT-provider leaf for this identity or any GPT workflow record for it, not even as a precedent. Packet bytes, workflow digest and declared efforts are unchanged.
